newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stockpile sells 17.86 million pounds of zinc.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stockpile sells 17.86 million pounds of zinc.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 17,862,000 pounds (8,102 tonnes) of zinc for $8,767,128 or an average price of 49 cents per pound.
The highest bid was by Commercial Alloys Corp for 680,000 lbs of prime western material at 50.21 cents per pound.
The lowest bid was by Sogem-Afrimet for 2.2 million pounds of high grade material at 48.79 cents per pound.
Other companies who bought material were Hochschild Partners, I Schumann & Co, Trademet and Parks Pioneer Metals.
LME cash settled at the equivalent of 46.85 cents per pound on Thursday.
